Name: File Header
Description: The NITF file header defined in MIL-STD-2500C Section 5.2 and Table A-1. The fields contain identification and origination information, file-level security information, and the number and size of segments of each type contained in the file.

FHDR.Name: File Profile Name
FHDR.Description: A value uniquely denoting the format and profile of the file. In connection with FVER this denotes the file format.

FVER.Name: File Version
FVER.Description: A value uniquely denoting the version of the file. In connection with FHDR this denotes the file format.

CLEVEL.Name: Complexity Level
CLEVEL.Description: The complexity level required to interpret fully all components of the file.

STYPE.Name: Standard Type
STYPE.Description: The standard type or encoding of the file.

Values.BF01: File is formatted using ISO/IEC IS 12087-5

OSTAID.Name: Originating Station ID
OSTAID.Description: An identification code or name of the originating organization, system, station, or product.

FDT.Name: File Date and Time
FDT.Description: The time (UTC)(Zulu) of the file origination. UTC is assumed to be the time zone designator to express the time of day.

FTITLE.Name: File Title
FTITLE.Description: The title of the file, this should be unique.

FSCLAS.Name: File Security Classification
FSCLAS.Description: The classification level of the entire file, including all sub segments.

FSCLSY.Name: File Security Classification System
FSCLSY.Description: The national or multinational security system used to classify the file. Country Codes per FIPS PUB 10-4 shall be used to indicate national security systems. The designator 'XN' is for classified data generated by a component using NATO security system marking guidance. This code is outside the FIPS 10-4 document listing, and was selected to not duplicate that document's existing codes. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no security classification system applies to the file.

FSCODE.Name: File Codewords
FSCODE.Description: The security compartments associated with the file. Values include one or more of the digraphs. Multiple entries shall be separated by a single space. The selection of a relevant set of codewords is application specific. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no codewords apply to the file.

FSCTLH.Name: File Control and Handling
FSCTLH.Description: The additional security control and/or handling instructions (caveats) associated with the file. Values include digraphs. The digraph may indicate single or multiple caveats. The selection of a relevant caveat(s) is application specific. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no additional control and handling instructions apply to the file.

FSREL.Name: File Releasing Instructions
FSREL.Description: A list of country and/or multilateral entity codes to which countries and/or multilateral entities the file is authorized for release. Valid items in the list are one or more country codes as found in FIPS PUB 10-4 separated by a single space. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no file release instructions apply.

FSDCTP.Name: File Declassification Type
FSDCTP.Description: The indicator of the type of security declassification or downgrading instructions which apply to the file.

Values.DE: Declassify upon occurrence of an event
Values.GD: Downgrade to a specified level on a specific date
Values.GE: Downgrade to a specified level upon occurrence of an event
Values: No file security declassification or downgrading instructions

FSDCDT.Name: File Declassification Date
FSDCDT.Description: The date on which a file is to be declassified if the value of FSDCTP is 'DD'. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no file declassification date applies.

FSDCXM.Name: File Declassification Exemption
FSDCXM.Description: The reason the file is exempt from automatic declassification if the value of FSDCTP is 'X'. Valid values are X1 to X8 and X251 to X259. X1 to X8 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.1-R, paragraphs 4-202b(1) to (8) for material exempt from the 10-year rule. X251 to X259 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.1-R, paragraphs 4-301a(1) to (9) for permanently valuable material exempt from the 25-year declassification system. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that a file declassification exemption does not apply.

FSDG.Name: File Downgradee
FSDG.Description: The classification level to which a file is to be downgraded if the values of FSDCTP are 'GD' or 'GE'.

Values: File security downgrading does not apply

FSDGDT.Name: File Downgrade Date
FSDGDT.Description: The date on which a file is to be downgraded if the value of FSDCTP is 'GD'. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that a file security downgrading date does not apply.

FSCLTX.Name: File Classification Text
FSCLTX.Description: The additional information about file classification to include identification of a declassification or downgrading event if the values in FSDCTP are 'DE' or 'GE'. It may also be used to identify multiple classification sources and/or any other special handling rules. Values are user defined free text. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that additional information about file classification does not apply.

FSCATP.Name: File Classification Authority Type
FSCATP.Description: The type of authority used to classify the file.

Values: File classification authority type does not apply

FSCAUT.Name: File Classification Authority
FSCAUT.Description: The classification authority for the file dependent upon the value in FSCATP. Values are user defined free text which should contain the following information: original classification authority name and position or personal identifier if the value in File Classification Authority Type is O; title of the document or security classification guide used to classify the file if the value in File Classification Authority Type is D; and Derive-Multiple if the file classification was derived from multiple sources and the value of the FSCATP field is M. In the latter case, the file originator will maintain a record of the sources used in accordance with existing security directives. One of the multiple sources may also be identified in File Classification Text if desired. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no file classification authority applies.

FSCRSN.Name: File Classification Reason
FSCRSN.Description: The reason for classifying the file. Valid values are A to G. These correspond to the reasons for original classification per E.O. 12958, Section 1.5.(a) to (g). If this field contains a space, it shall imply that no file classification reason applies.

FSRDT.Name: File Security Source Date
FSRDT.Description: The date of the source used to derive the classification of the file. In the case of multiple sources, the date of the most recent source shall be used. If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that a file security source date does not apply.

FSCTLN.Name: File Security Control Number
FSCTLN.Description: A valid security control number associated with the file. The format of the security control number shall be in accordance with the regulations governing the appropriate security channel(s). If this field is all spaces, it shall imply that no file security control number applies.

FSCOP.Name: File Copy Number
FSCOP.Description: This field shall contain the copy number of the file. If this field is all zeros, it shall imply that there is no tracking of numbered file copies.

FSCPYS.Name: File Number of Copies
FSCPYS.Description: The total number of copies of the file. If this field is all zeros, it shall imply that there is no tracking of numbered file copies.

ENCRYP.Name: Encryption Status
ENCRYP.Description: The value zero until such time as this specification is updated to define the use of other values.

FBKGC.Name: File Background Color
FBKGC.Description: The three color components of the file background in the order Red, Green, Blue. Where (0x00, 0x00, 0x00) is black and (0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) is white.

ONAME.Name: Originator Name
ONAME.Description: A valid name for the operator who originated the file. If the field is all spaces, it shall represent that no operator is assigned responsibility for origination.

OPHONE.Name: Originator Phone Number
OPHONE.Description: A valid phone number for the operator who originated the file. If the field is all spaces, it shall represent that no phone number is available for the operator assigned responsibility for origination.

FL.Name: File Length
FL.Description: The length in bytes of the entire file including all headers, subheaders, and data. Note: The largest file is limited to 999,999,999,998 bytes. A value of 999999999999 in this field indicates that the actual file length was not available when the header was created.

HL.Name: File Header Length
HL.Description: The length in bytes of the NITF file header, this includes all data up to XHD (File TREs).

NUMI.Name: Number of Image Segments
NUMI.Description: The number of separate image segments included in the file.

LISH<NUMI>.Name: Length of Image Subheader
LISH<NUMI>.Description: The length in bytes for the image subheader. Note: The largest image subheader is limited to 999,998 bytes. A value of 999999 in this field indicates that the actual subheader length was not available when the header was created.

LI<NUMI>.Name: Length of Image Segment
LI<NUMI>.Description: The valid length in bytes of the image segment, Size of image data not including header. If the segment is compressed, the length after compression shall be used. Note: The largest image is limited to 9,999,999,998 bytes. A value of 9999999999 in this field indicates that the actual length was not available when the header was created.

NUMS.Name: Number of Graphic Segments
NUMS.Description: The number of separate graphic segments included in the file.

LSSH<NUMS>.Name: Length of Graphic Subheader
LSSH<NUMS>.Description: The length in bytes for the graphic subheader. Note: The largest graphic subheader is limited to 9,998 bytes. A value of 9999 in this field indicates that the actual subheader length was not available when the header was created.

LS<NUMS>.Name: Length of Graphic Segment
LS<NUMS>.Description: The valid length in bytes of the graphic segment, Size of graphic data not including header. If the segment is compressed, the length after compression shall be used. Note: The largest graphic is limited to 999,998 bytes. A value of 999999 in this field indicates that the actual length was not available when the header was created.

NUMX.Name: Reserved for Future Use
NUMX.Description: This is Reserved for Future Use. No Current Users.

NUMT.Name: Number of Text Segments
NUMT.Description: The number of separate text segments included in the file.

LTSH<NUMT>.Name: Length of Text Subheader
LTSH<NUMT>.Description: The length in bytes for the text subheader. Note: The largest text subheader is limited to 9,998 bytes. A value of 9999 in this field indicates that the actual subheader length was not available when the header was created.

LT<NUMT>.Name: Length of Text Segment
LT<NUMT>.Description: The valid length in bytes of the text segment, Size of text data not including header. If the segment is compressed, the length after compression shall be used. Note: The largest text is limited to 99,998 bytes. A value of 99999 in this field indicates that the actual length was not available when the header was created.

NUMDES.Name: Number of Data Extension Segments
NUMDES.Description: The number of separate data extension segments included in the file.

LDSH<NUMDES>.Name: Length of Data Extension Subheader
LDSH<NUMDES>.Description: The length in bytes for the data extension subheader. Note: The largest data extension subheader is limited to 9,998 bytes. A value of 9999 in this field indicates that the actual subheader length was not available when the header was created.

LD<NUMDES>.Name: Length of Data Extension Segment
LD<NUMDES>.Description: The valid length in bytes of the data extension segment, Size of data extension not including header. If the segment is compressed, the length after compression shall be used. Note: The largest data extension is limited to 999,999,998 bytes. A value of 999999999 in this field indicates that the actual length was not available when the header was created.

NUMRES.Name: Number of Reserved Extension Segments
NUMRES.Description: The number of separate reserved data extension segments included in the file.

LRSH<NUMRES>.Name: Length of Reserved Extension Subheader
LRSH<NUMRES>.Description: The length in bytes for the reserved data extension subheader. Note: The largest reserved data extension subheader is limited to 9,998 bytes. A value of 9999 in this field indicates that the actual subheader length was not available when the header was created.

LR<NUMRES>.Name: Length of Reserved Extension Segment
LR<NUMRES>.Description: The valid length in bytes of the reserved data extension segment, Size of reserved data extension not including header. If the segment is compressed, the length after compression shall be used. Note: The largest reserved data extension is limited to 9,999,998 bytes. A value of 9999999 in this field indicates that the actual length was not available when the header was created.

UDHDL.Name: User Defined Header Data Length
UDHDL.Description: The field shall contain the sum of the length of all the TREs appearing in the UDHD field plus 3 bytes (length of UDHOFL field). If a TRE is too long to fit in the UDHD field, it shall be put in the TRE overflow DES with DESID set to the value TRE_OVERFLOW.

UDHOFL.Name: User Defined Header Overflow
UDHOFL.Description: The sequence number of the DES into which TREs overflow. This field shall be omitted if the field UDHDL contains zeros.

UDHD.Name: User Defined Data
UDHD.Description: The user-defined TRE data. The length of this field shall be the value contained by the UDHDL field minus 3 bytes.

XHDL.Name: Extended Header Data Length
XHDL.Description: The field shall contain the sum of the length of all the TREs appearing in the XHD field plus 3 bytes (length of UDHOFL field). If a TRE is too long to fit in the XHD field, it shall be put in the TRE overflow DES with DESID set to the value TRE_OVERFLOW.

XHDLOFL.Name: Extended Header Data Overflow
XHDLOFL.Description: The sequence number of the DES into which TREs overflow. This field shall be omitted if the field XHDL contains zeros.

XHD.Name: Extended Header Data
XHD.Description: The extended header TRE data. The length of this field shall be the value contained by the XHDL field minus 3 bytes.
